claims.statement: Production images are built and pushed exclusively as linux/amd64 and tagged :latest; base images are mirrored into GHCR via make mirror-bases and pinned by digest in the Dockerfiles so platform drift cannot introduce an arm64 image into production.

Production deploy runs make deploy which performs (1) frontend Vite multi-stage linux/amd64 build and push to GHCR as :latest, (2) backend Go build and push tagged both :latest and :GIT_SHA, then (3) SSH to the production host to pull and recreate frontend and backend containers with --force-recreate --no-deps; MySQL and Redis are not touched.

Database restore is a separate make restore target: stop the api-server, apply the logical MySQL dump, restore assets/, run migrations forward to current head, restart the api-server, then issue DELETE /api/v1/cache (admin-only) so cached aggregates do not serve pre-restore state.
